entries.75884c0eb192ab3e: It positions medical devices and healthcare-related fields as priority areas for the Electronic Circuit Board Business and states that it will work on technology development for high-density multilayer boards. It treats FPC prototyping and mass production of small and medium lots as the pillars of its business, and also states that it will advance the provision of electronics manufacturing services (EMS) covering everything from circuit design to modularization and final product assembly. In the Test Systems Business, it positions the power device market, which is expected to grow on the back of AI, EVs and high-speed communications, as a priority growth area, and states that it will work on improving the defect detection capability and inspection accuracy of inspection equipment for ceramic substrates and expanding sales channels through partnerships with sales agents.
entries.8d311631c16c0e41: This is a reportable segment that mainly manufactures and sells flexible printed circuit boards (FPCs). From circuit pattern design through drilling, plating, etching and final inspection, the company handles everything in-house except component mounting, responding to short-lead-time needs for prototypes and small-lot production. It also manufactures and sells electroformed products. Consolidated subsidiaries in Thailand and Shanghai handle product sales and service and support. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,409 million.
entries.8f3ad78be9b62bdd: The description of the Electronic Circuit Board Business in [Business Overview].
entries.9a74da8879e0200d: Because the Electronic Circuit Board Business has long specialized in labor-intensive FPC prototype work, it has built up production process management systems and know-how that enable short lead times and small-lot production. From wiring pattern design through drilling, plating, etching and final inspection, everything except component mounting can be handled in-house in an integrated system, and including pattern design, it achieves delivery within a minimum of 3 days from order receipt.
entries.9be8e0318b582c5b: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells cylindrical mirror-finish grinding machines, which give super mirror finishes to surfaces of gravure plate-making rolls, aluminum rolling rolls and similar items. Consolidated subsidiary Mirack Co., Ltd. manufactures these machines, and the company sells them. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥445 million.
